narrative.summary: APEC Leaders endorsed the APEC Artificial Intelligence (AI) Initiative (2026-2030) in the Gyeongju Declaration of 1 November 2025, setting voluntary goals on AI transformation, AI capacity building and investment in resilient AI infrastructure. APEC ministers responsible for digital and AI issued joint ministerial statements in 2025 (Incheon) and 2026 (Chengdu) in which AI is a central theme. APEC texts are voluntary and non-binding.
lead_institutions: APEC Digital and AI Ministerial Meeting

instruments.summary: Five-year APEC initiative on AI. It sets three objectives (resilient growth through secure, accessible AI ecosystems; meaningful participation in AI transformation through cooperation and capacity building; and energy-efficient AI with resilient infrastructure investment) and three strategic goals: advancing AI transformation within APEC, building AI capacities in the public and private sectors and the workforce, and cultivating investment in resilient AI infrastructure. APEC fora are encouraged to integrate it, with progress reviews and a final review in 2030.
instruments.current_status: Endorsed by APEC Economic Leaders in the 2025 APEC Leaders' Gyeongju Declaration (Gyeongju, Republic of Korea, 1 November 2025). Voluntary; implementation is reviewed through the Digital Economy Steering Group.
instruments.evidence_reference: Initiative page prints no separate date; endorsement in Gyeongju Declaration para 15 ('We hereby endorse the APEC AI Initiative'); declaration dated 'Gyeongju, Republic of Korea, 1 November 2025' on apec.org leaders' declarations listing. Classified as regional_strategy (initiative with goals and review cycle).

instruments.summary: Joint statement of APEC ministers responsible for digital and AI issues. It encourages the secure and responsible adoption of AI and other digital technologies to raise productivity and resilience, commits to continued cooperation to build trust, safety, fairness and confidence in AI, and asks for an APEC AI initiative to be developed under Korea's leadership by the end of 2025.
instruments.current_status: Issued by APEC ministers at the Digital and AI Ministerial Meeting, Incheon, Republic of Korea, 4-6 August 2025. Political statement; non-binding.
instruments.evidence_reference: Page prints 'Incheon, Republic of Korea, 4-6 August 2025'; month given only. AI in 8 of 14 numbered paragraphs.

instruments.summary: Joint statement of APEC ministers responsible for telecommunications, information and AI. It encourages AI adoption through voluntary capacity building, training, technical assistance and public education, including for policymakers; supports human-centred, locally tailored AI services that improve public service delivery; and commits to sharing practice on AI-driven sector transformation and cooperating on mitigating misuse and other AI risks.
instruments.current_status: Issued by APEC ministers meeting in Chengdu, People's Republic of China, on 23 July 2026. Political statement; non-binding.
instruments.evidence_reference: Page prints 'Chengdu, People's Republic of China, 23 July 2026'; opens 'We, the APEC Ministers responsible for telecommunications/information...'. AI in about 12 of 18 paragraphs.
